grouping: Both order contrasts stay together. Action-pair groups are sorted by SHA256 of their group id and assigned 60 train, 20 calibration, 20 test. Templates and vocabulary are shared across splits; this measures compositional recombination only.
rule: Label 1 iff the run clause contains the designated forbidden action. The quote clause is inert in this artificial grammar. This is not a general prompt-injection policy.
